changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapGraph_backup') BEGIN drop table [dbo].[MapGraph_backup]; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapGraph_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapGraph_backup]( [Subject] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Predicate] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Sequence] [smallint] NOT NULL ) END
